item_name: Rothco Canvas Camo and Solid Tote Bag
item_short_desc: Rothco's Canvas Camo and Solid Tote Bag is the ideal carry-all solution for your everyday needs. Made from durable, lightweight cotton canvas, this tote bag is designed to withstand daily wear and tear while providing ample space for your items. Measuring 18 inches x 15 inches x 5 inches, it offers a roomy interior that can accommodate groceries, and more. Whether you're heading to the store, the library, or a casual outing, this versatile tote bag ensures you have everything you need within easy reach.
